name: calHurt
description: Applies final damage resistance layer including PvE damage bonus and general/PvE damage resistance. Called by all damage formulas after base damage calculation.

formula_steps.description: Apply PvE damage bonus from attacker
Apply general damage resistance and PvE damage resistance from defender
formula_steps.formula: dmg = roundInt(roundInt(dmg * round(1 - resist)) * round(1 - pve_resist))

simplified_formula: max(1, roundInt(roundInt(roundInt(dmg * round(1 + pve_dam)) * round(1 - resist)) * round(1 - pve_resist)))
